correctness.rationale: For each vertex v, phi_0 makes every vertex of the induced closed neighborhood N[v] have internal degree at least 3: the center has ambient degree at least 3, while each neighbor lies with v in exactly two triangles and therefore has v plus two distinct common neighbors inside N[v]. Thus N[v] has no removable vertex, so psi_n implies |N[v]|>n and hence deg(v)>=n. The genus inequality follows rigorously from the handshaking lemma, |V|>=n+1, and the standard orientable edge bound E<=3V-6+6g.

value.rationale: Lockhart's pseudofiniteness theorem relies on higher-genus finite approximants but quantifies neither their necessary local density nor their topological cost. The accepted theorem shows that every finite model at axiom depth n has minimum degree at least n and therefore requires orientable genus on the order of n^2. This is a natural structural constraint on all approximation schemes and strictly strengthens the source's planar obstruction.
